knowledge:
- key_parameters: param.detection=A matrix containing parameters for both steps of the detection procedure, obtained via getDefaultParameter() or modified via createParameterMatrix() ;; lambda=Influences the number of normal distributions selected by the mixture model via BIC; default is 1 ;; beta=Prior parameter for the variance of normal distributions to capture isolated outliers; default is 6 in Step 1 and 0 in Step 2 ;; per=Percentage threshold representing the maximum percentage of conditions in which a gene can be specific; default is 0.1 (Step 1) and 0.3 (Step 2) ;; md=Median difference threshold; the minimum distance between the medians of two normal components to consider one an outlier; default is 0.75 ;; mlk=Minimum log-likelihood ratio threshold to identify well-separated outlier clusters; default is 5 (Step 1) and 25 (Step 2) ;; rsd=Minimum standard deviation ratio threshold to identify highly spread-out outlier clusters; default is 0.1 ;; pv=P-value threshold to define a condition as specific using adjusted p-values; default is 0.05 ;; multitest.correction.method=The multiple testing correction method applied to p-values; default is "BY" ;; condition.factor=A factor mapping samples to conditions when using an ExpressionSet input ;; condition.method=The method ("mean", "median", or "max") used to summarize samples by condition when using an ExpressionSet input
- alternatives: None mentioned in the documentation, though standard p-value adjustment methods from p.adjust are referenced.
- when_to_use: Use this package when you have gene expression data across multiple conditions (e.g., tissues, organs, environmental treatments) and want to identify genes that act as outliers (specifically up- or down-regulated) in only a small subset of those conditions.
- pitfalls: Ensure that the input expression matrix is log2-transformed. When modifying parameters, always adhere to the recommended rules: beta.2 must be 0, md.1 must equal md.2, per.1 must be less than or equal to per.2, and pv.1 must equal pv.2. If using an ExpressionSet, you must extract the summarized matrix using getMatrixFromExpressionSet with the exact same condition.factor and condition.method arguments to ensure compatibility with downstream visualization functions.

workflows.name: standard_specond_analysis
workflows.intent: Perform a complete condition-specific gene detection analysis in a single function call and generate HTML and text reports.
input: expression_matrix.txt (matrix of log2 expression values with genes as rows and conditions as columns)
expression_set.RData (optional ExpressionSet object containing expression data and phenotype metadata)
workflows.stages: 1. Run the full SpeCond analysis to fit mixture models and detect outliers ;; 2. Generate a comprehensive HTML results page with barplots and heatmaps ;; 3. Generate individual HTML pages for each gene to visualize expression profiles and density curves ;; 4. Export specific gene profiles, unique profiles, and gene summaries to text files
workflows.code:
generalResult=SpeCond(Mexp, param.detection=NULL, multitest.correction.method="BY", prefix.file="E", print.hist.pv=TRUE, fit1=NULL, fit2=NULL, specificOutlierStep1=NULL)
specificResult=generalResult$specificResult
getFullHtmlSpeCondResult(SpeCondResult=generalResult, param.detection=specificResult$param.detection, page.name="Example_SpeCond_results", page.title="Tissue specific results", sort.condition="all", heatmap.profile=TRUE, heatmap.expression=FALSE, heatmap.unique.profile=FALSE, expressionMatrix=Mexp)
genePageInfo=getGeneHtmlPage(Mexp, specificResult, name.index.html="index_example_SpeCond_Results.html", gene.html.ids=c(1:20))
L.specific.result.profile=getProfile(specificResult$L.specific.result$M.specific)
writeSpeCondResult(specificResult$L.specific.result,file.name.profile="Example_specific_profile.txt", file.specific.gene="Example_list_specific_gene.txt", file.name.unique.profile="Example_specific_unique_profile.txt")
writeUniqueProfileSpecificResult(L.specific.result=specificResult$L.specific.result, file.name.unique.profile="Example_specific_unique_profile.txt", full.list.gene=FALSE)
writeGeneResult(specificResult$L.specific.result, file.name.result.gene="Example_gene_gummary_result.txt", gene.names=rownames(Mexp)[1:10])

workflows.name: stepwise_specond_analysis
workflows.intent: Perform condition-specific gene detection step-by-step to allow saving of intermediate fits and efficient parameter tuning.
input: expression_matrix.txt (matrix of log2 expression values with genes as rows and conditions as columns)
workflows.stages: 1. Fit the mixture model with a prior on variance (Step 1) ;; 2. Detect single outliers from Step 1 ;; 3. Fit the mixture model excluding Step 1 outliers (Step 2) ;; 4. Detect final condition-specific genes and obtain the specific results
workflows.code:
param.detection=getDefaultParameter()
fit1=fitPrior(Mexp, param.detection=param.detection)
specificOutlierStep1=getSpecificOutliersStep1(Mexp, fit=fit1$fit1,param.detection, multitest.correction.method="BY", prefix.file="run1_Step1", print.hist.pv=FALSE)
fit2=fitNoPriorWithExclusion(Mexp, specificOutlierStep1=specificOutlierStep1, param.detection=param.detection)
specificResult=getSpecificResult(Mexp, fit=fit2, specificOutlierStep1=specificOutlierStep1, param.detection, multitest.correction.method="BY", prefix.file="run1_Step2", print.hist.pv=FALSE)
